original_test_intent: Validate the project's approved correctable-RAS injection path and confirm that BMC event logging reports the exact injected source, location, severity and correction behavior; whether the intended feature is memory ADDC or GMI-link correctable handling remains an explicit scope decision.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify CPU stepping, topology, ECC RDIMMs, BIOS/BMC/AGESA/OS, HDT and signed AMD tool; preserve all BIOS pre-state and logs; resolve the authoritative fault class and map tool link/location values to physical IOD/CCD/GMI or memory resources; apply only the approved BIOS deviations with rollback; unlock through the controlled HDT procedure; list and verify topology; capture pre-injection SEL/MCA/RAS state; inject one approved correctable event; correlate tool output, host MCA/EDAC/APEI evidence and BMC SEL fields/timestamp; restore BIOS/HDT state and stop on any fatal or unexpected event.
manual_activity: An engineer provisions HDT and the licensed AMD tool, approves BIOS deviations and physical target mapping, supervises one injection and owns console recovery and rollback.
required_inputs: Authoritative decision whether this case targets ADDC memory correction or GMI/IOD/CCD correctable error logging
HDT version/unlock procedure and AMD tool binary version/hash/license
Exact link number, error location/traffic/type and mapping to physical source
Expected host MCA/EDAC/APEI and BMC SEL sensor/type/severity/location/payload/timestamp oracle
BIOS original values, rollback, crash/reimage and console recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated non-production SUT with workload/data isolation and independent console
Verify each nondefault BIOS value and preserve a rollback record before HDT unlock
Resolve link/location mapping; never assume link 0 belongs to the intended resource
Preserve existing SEL/host logs and inject only one approved correctable event
Abort on uncorrectable/fatal escalation, sync flood, hang, reset, wrong target, error storm, thermal/power anomaly or lost console; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate identities, tool provenance, BIOS delta, topology/target mapping, oracle, approval and recovery
Collect read-only baseline and one approved injection's complete tool/host/BMC evidence
Do not unlock CPU, change BIOS or inject until separate execution confirmation and engineer supervision
Do not reinterpret ADDC, guess link/location, clear logs, broaden/repeat injection, recover automatically or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve the title/procedure mismatch and approve exact fault-class coverage
Approve BIOS/HDT/tool/topology parameters and BMC/host event oracle
Review injection/recovery evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title says `Add ADDC function`, an ECC-memory correction feature, while the specified tool commands inject IOD and CCD correctable errors on a GMI link. Criteria merely says correct RAS information and cannot resolve which fault class is authoritative.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2218 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00001-V002: decide whether authoritative coverage is ADDC memory correction or the literal GMI/IOD/CCD correctable injections (or separate cases); approve CPU/platform/BIOS/BMC/AGESA/RDIMM/OS support, HDT and AMD tool version/hash/license, BIOS before/target/rollback values, exact link/location/traffic/error mapping, one-injection limit, expected host MCA/EDAC/APEI plus BMC SEL sensor/type/severity/location/payload/timing, abort thresholds and console/reimage recovery.

review_improvement: Exposes the ADDC/GMI semantic mismatch and converts a high-risk injection into a single attributable event with deterministic host/BMC evidence, rollback and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: ADDC ordinarily concerns memory-device error correction, while the source tool flags explicitly name GMI and distinguish IOD from CCD locations. Treating either label as interchangeable would validate the wrong RAS path. A correctable injection is only meaningful when its physical link/resource is mapped and the BMC record is matched to the same timestamp, source and severity; a generic SEL entry could be unrelated. BIOS threshold changes and HDT unlock alter protection behavior, so their exact deltas and rollback are part of the test, not incidental setup.
